title: NVIDIA T4 GPUs reach end of support on Google Cloud
summary: Google Cloud's NVIDIA T4 GPU offering reaches end of support on August 1, 2027, per Google's own EOL lifecycle page for the T4 accelerator.

title: Google Play requires new apps/updates to target API level 37 (Android 18)
summary: Following Google's established yearly cadence (API level 36 became mandatory August 31, 2026), Google is expected to require new apps and updates to target API level 37 for Play Store distribution around August 2027.

sources.title: Target API level requirements for Google Play apps

title: EU AI Act full compliance deadline for pre-existing general-purpose AI models
summary: General-purpose AI models that were already on the EU market before August 2, 2025 received a one-year grace period and must meet full AI Act GPAI obligations by August 2, 2027.

sources.title: EU AI Obligations for GPAI Providers: Compliance, Enforcement & Deadlines (2025-2027)

title: DEF CON 35
summary: DEF CON confirmed via its own account that DEF CON 35 runs August 5-8, 2027 at the Las Vegas Convention Center.

sources.title: DEF CON 35: 5-8 Aug 2027 LVCC + DEF CON 34 Recap

title: Microsoft retires HPC Pack (end of support)
summary: All versions of Microsoft HPC Pack reach end of support, closing a one-year retirement-only support period; Azure Batch is the suggested migration target.
